title: Subtle Modals
rule: At C2, modals convey nuance, criticism, and probability.

examples.text: You might have been more diplomatic.
She couldn't have known the outcome.
He would rather have remained silent.
They needn't have apologized so profusely.
That will have been his final decision.

practicePrompt: Complete: You ___ (might / consider) the ethical implications more carefully.
